# Accelerator X

> Accelerator X is a UK AI enablement consultancy for business leaders. We build
> human capability with AI systems: strategy, hands-on implementation, and the
> skills for your people to run it without us. Founded and delivered by Andy
> Carroll and Toby Henry. Registered in England as Accelerator X Ltd, company
> number 16974247.

The company name is written "Accelerator X": two words, no hyphen. The hyphen
appears only in the domain name (accelerator-x.ai). We are not affiliated with
other organisations that use similar names.

## What we offer

Two ways in:

- **For your business:** [Company Enablement](https://accelerator-x.ai/what-we-do/company-enablement/).
  How a company moves with us: everyone starts at Phase 0.
- **For yourself or your leadership team:** Leadership AI Coaching, in three formats:
  - [1:1 Exec AI Fast Track Coaching](https://accelerator-x.ai/what-we-do/senior-leader-acceleration/):
    a bespoke 6-week 1:1 AI sprint with a founder.
  - [Leadership Team AI Activation](https://accelerator-x.ai/what-we-do/leadership-activation/):
    a leadership team that moves together.
  - [Open Cohort AI Bootcamp for Business Leaders](https://accelerator-x.ai/what-we-do/leadership-cohort/):
    build your own AI Chief of Staff in eight weeks, with peers.

Plus [Talks & Events](https://accelerator-x.ai/talks-events/): AI keynotes,
leadership offsites, and AI hackathons.

All coaching, training and enablement work carries a "no value, no payment"
guarantee; one-off talks and events are the exception. Current pricing is
published on each offering page.

## Who we work with

Leadership teams and senior executives of mid-sized businesses, mostly in the UK.
Our clients are the people who have to decide whether to back AI, how much to
spend, and how to explain it to their board. We build capability that stays with
the client, not dependency on us.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://accelerator-x.ai/): what we do, and how to apply to work with us.
- [What we do](https://accelerator-x.ai/what-we-do/): the two doors in, side by side.
- [How we work](https://accelerator-x.ai/how-we-work/): the phase-based engagement model.
- [About](https://accelerator-x.ai/about/): the founders, and why Accelerator X exists.
- [Insights](https://accelerator-x.ai/insights/): articles on AI strategy, capability,
  and implementation, written by the founders.
- [FAQ](https://accelerator-x.ai/faq/): common questions, straight answers.
- [Contact](https://accelerator-x.ai/contact/): how to reach us.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://quiz.accelerator-x.ai): a short self-assessment
  with an on-screen result and an emailed PDF report (requires an email address).

## Contact

info@accelerator-x.ai reaches both founders. We reply within 1 business day.

## This site

https://accelerator-x.ai is static HTML, built with deliberate engineering rigour.
The codebase is public: https://github.com/acc-x/accelerator-x-website

The build system, automated standards enforcement, and documentation architecture
are themselves a demonstration of how we think about AI-assisted work. The repo
is worth reading if you want to understand how we operate.

## For AI agents working in this codebase

Read `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` first. They tell you exactly how we work here.
The core principle: we move fast by not making messes.
Standards are enforced by automation, not memory or discipline.
